subject: Post-call: CloudBridge decision gaps and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & open decision items

Emma — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and the open asks we promised to follow up on: 

Attendees: Emma (CloudBridge), Mary Chen (finance, brief intro), Samuel Ortiz (procurement, intro over email), Hannah (Redwood, GTM), Marcus (Redwood, AE), Neha (Redwood, SE)

Key takeaways (short):
- Primary use case: real-time chat assistant for customer support with up to ~120 concurrent agents initially, scaling to ~800 over 12 months.
- Decision drivers: predictable latency, unit cost, and security/data residency.
- Preferred deployment: Dedicated reserved capacity or Private VPC (you flagged data controls preference).

Open / action items we captured:
1) Economic buyer: you indicated Mary Chen (CFO) will sign off. Please confirm.
2) Procurement path: you said procurement@cloudbridge.ai + Samuel will own PO/SOW. We'll need a standard SOW and PO template.
3) Security checklist: you asked for SOC2 summary and KMS/HSM details — attaching a short SOC2_summary.pdf and our standard RFI stub (CloudBridge_RFI.pdf).
4) Decision criteria clarification you asked us to confirm:
   - Latency target: 95th percentile < 200ms for typical 1-2 turn interactions (prompt ~80 tokens, response ~120 tokens) — is that still the target?
   - Cost goal: target line-of-business ceiling of ~$8 per 1M tokens (rough guidance).
   - SLA: request for 99.9% uptime with an escalation contact and financial SLA language.
   - Deployment options: Dedicated reserved vs Private VPC (air-gapped not required, but strict VPC controls and customer-managed KMS).

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus will share pricing bands and expected committed-capacity discounts (attached).
- Neha to send a short perf estimate and propose a 1-hour proof-of-performance window to exercise realistic QPS.
- Hannah to introduce Rishi (legal) once procurement signals readiness for redlines.

Please reply with any corrections and confirm Mary + Samuel as the economic/procurement leads so we can route the next docs appropriately.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: CloudBridge_RFI.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@cloudbridge.ai>, Mary Chen <mary.chen@cloudbridge.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & open decision items

Thanks Hannah — good recap. Quick confirmations and a couple of clarifying Qs: 

- Mary Chen (CFO) is the economic buyer — correct. She'd like a short one-pager on total cost of ownership (3-year view) and the committed capacity breakpoints.
- Samuel is procurement lead (cc'd). He will need Redwood's standard SOW + PO instructions and the invoice/contact for AP.
- Security: SOC2 summary received — we still need details on KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) and whether audit logs can be forwarded to our Splunk instance.

Clarifying questions:
1) The latency target — 95th <200ms — is aggressive for some LLMs. Can you provide an expected latency band for Dedicated small (2 GPU), medium (8 GPU) and an estimate for a Private VPC 8x A100-equivalent pod?
2) Are you able to support a short performance window (1 hour) that mirrors our peak QPS pattern (burst to ~450 QPS for ~10 minutes every 20 minutes)?

Timeline: we'd like to land procurement approvals by end of Q3 (Sept 30). If Redwood can provide the cost/TCO and perf window by next week, we'll prioritize internal review.

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of AI Platform, CloudBridge
emma.liu@cloudbridge.ai

To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@cloudbridge.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & open decision items

Emma — confirmed on Mary and Samuel. Marcus and I attached the pricing bands (Redwood_pricing_bands.pdf) — high level callouts:
- Committed Dedicated: tiered discounts at 3mo / 6mo / 12mo commitments; material step-down at 12mo.
- Private VPC: one-time infra onboarding fee + higher baseline unit cost vs hosted Dedicated; clear mapping in the attached PDF.

We can absolutely run the 1-hour perf window. Proposed slots are attached as an invite (Tech-DeepDive-Slot-Invite.ics) — please pick one and we'll lock it. Neha will lead the test configuration.

Next: Rishi (legal) — I'd like to include you once Samuel confirms procurement cadence so we can align on redlines quickly.

Hannah

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@cloudbridge.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Technical perf note + proposed test config

Emma / team — quick technical note to set expectations for the perf window and latency bands. High-level:

- Baseline assumptions: prompt length ~80 tokens, completion ~120 tokens; model family similar to open-llm-3 style with 8k context.
- Recommended config for target: Dedicated medium (8x GPU pool) with continuous batching + prefix KV cache. This typically yields 95th percentile latency around 150-260ms depending on concurrency shape. We can tune to push the 95p closer to 200ms by increasing concurrency shard count and enabling quantized kernels.
- For Private VPC (8x equivalent), expect slightly higher cold-start overhead during autoscaling; steady-state 95p should be comparable with local networking optimizations in place.
- Burst pattern (450 QPS bursts): we'll simulate with a client script. To pass the test, we recommend a warm-up phase (15 minutes) and then the 60-minute window that replicates your 20-minute burst cadence.

I've attached a quick perf-estimate.csv with two example configs and expected cost per 1M tokens. Notes: our conservative cost estimate is $7.50-9.50 per 1M tokens depending on compression/quantization. If your procurement target is <$8, we can propose a 12mo committed plan to get beneath that threshold.

Next steps for the test:
- You send a short sample trace or synthetic pattern (or we can use our script).
- We schedule the slot — I'll own the test runs and gather 95/99/99.9p latencies and token counts.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: perf-estimate.csv

Subject: Next steps and immediate asks

Thanks everyone — quick operational checklist to keep momentum: 
1) Emma / Samuel: confirm the PO owner and expected payment terms (Net30/Net45) and send any required vendor onboarding docs to procurement@redwood.com.
2) Mary: we'll prepare a 3-year TCO one-pager and schedule a 20-minute call to run through the economics — available next Tue/Wed.
3) CloudBridge: pick a perf slot from the invite and send either a sample trace or confirm we can use the synthetic script.
4) Rishi (cc): once procurement gives the go-ahead, we'll share a starter SOW for quick review. Please keep redline turnaround target to 5 business days if possible.

I'll track these in our deal record and send a short follow-up on Monday with the materials we've attached here.

Regards,
